evidence.reason: The finding alleged that a health observation error (e.g. PermissionError from an unlistable state/runs) rethrows and exits with prose on stderr and no JSON on stdout. The current code no longer does this: the except block at lines 2247-2257 special-cases args.operation == "health", calls _error_artifact("thrown", args.operation, message, 1) and prints it to stdout unconditionally, narrates to stderr only when not parser.json_mode, and returns 1 to retain the health observation exit-1 contract. That is exactly the requested behavior: a structured I1 error artifact on stdout in machine mode with exit 1. The history contains the fixing commits (f7c00b9e...: emit JSON error artifact when a health observation raises; 1a8e1373...: serialize health error artifact on stdout for I1), with the latter producing the stdout serialization described here.
